notes.title: Time to Reinvent the Hotel Phobia
notes.content:
The Silence of Those Abandoned Corridors... It's Back.


Do you remember the tension you felt when you cracked open the door to Hotel Greenwood? The hesitation in front of room 352... That eerie atmosphere where every shadow hid a secret, and every creak froze your blood...


You solved that mystery. Congratulations.


We at SKYFOSTER were watching you. And we saw that... you love fear. Especially the claustrophobic and eerie horror that takes place in hotels.


That's why we built a new place just for you: the De'Manor Hotel, where Final Signature takes place.
But this time, we've completely changed the rules.

This Time, You're Not the Detective. You're the Prey.


In Hotel Greenwood, you were safe. You were an observer. You collected evidence, took notes, and watched the haunted past from a distance.


You don't have that luxury in the De'Manor Hotel.
You're not looking for evidence here. Because the biggest "mystery" in this hotel is the other contestant standing right next to you, smiling. The biggest "clue" is the glint in the eye of the person planning to eliminate you with their next move.


This isn't a ghost story. This is a story of betrayal, paranoia, and survival.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718131/f60d5c211965b6957c5bde2888dad0c9a7b07181.png"]



Do you have the courage to move on to the next level of fear?


Adding Final Signature to your wishlist is like a pre-registration for the De'Manor Hotel. 

An irreversible signature.


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3600200/Final_Signature/"][/dynamiclink]
Welcome to your new nightmare.
[]
The SKYFOSTER & ALTERED GAMES Team
[/]

notes.title: Get ready to face your fears at DREAMSCAPE
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065749/e1149da5d75ec8907e18820c2922cfb004411734.png

Brace yourselves for a fright! 😈 SKYFOSTER is bringing THREE spine-chilling games to DREAMSCAPE!

Get ready to face your fears at DREAMSCAPE, Tokyo's horror indie game festival, on September 7th! We're thrilled to announce that we'll be showcasing THREE of our most terrifying titles, all classified under the RED BAND category:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065749/88dade756a980e1bf617e59630f9604bf0350660.png

🩸 Alessia's Dollhouse: Uncover the dark secrets lurking within the walls of a seemingly innocent dollhouse. This one is not for the faint of heart!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065749/ec87b9fd90f09fc2f2c0e1c62d9445b7728385be.png

🏨 Hotel Greenwood: Check in, but you may never check out. Experience a night of terror in a hotel haunted by its gruesome past.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065749/fd14503a1999ca0c9b6cfceb479e7c3c7be23e61.png

🎄 Christmas Night: Who says the holidays have to be jolly? Prepare for a Christmas you won't forget (or survive) in this twisted festive nightmare.

Join us at DREAMSCAPE for an unforgettable journey into the depths of horror. We dare you to play... if you think you can handle it. 😉
